change: Read the frozen canonical selection in source-row order once per shard, instead of performing one random disk lookup per input record.
unchanged_contract: Each admitted row must still match the frozen page ID, source shard and source row, and the same full/lead flag.
validation: Final verifier compares every installed row against the independently frozen global priority table; interrupted logs and uncommitted tails are preserved.
first_shard_recovery: Resume edition-v2 from the last committed row under the same source, priority and format configuration; no completed pack is overwritten.
